metadata.description: Claude Code skills and plugins marketplace

plugins.name: prepare-release
plugins.description: Automates release branch creation from develop and PR to master. Reads last tag from master, calculates next MINOR version, and opens release/x.x.x PR.

plugins.name: groot-queue
plugins.description: Support queue monitor for [Core] - Groot (SSHP). Lists, classifies, analyzes SLA risk, suggests solutions via runbooks, sends Slack alerts, and assigns unattended tickets using round-robin.

plugins.name: groot-kit
plugins.description: Colección de skills del equipo Groot para agentes AI: configuración de Jira, rules de plataforma, y otros artefactos reutilizables de meli, nordic y andes.
